R1955.summary: The ministerial rescript in the King's name to his envoy in London, opening in clear 'Toutes vos dépêches m'ont été bien rendues et la dernière est du 14e de ce mois', then 362 code groups. WAINUT decoded 95 of 360 groups (26.4%) with the envoy table rebuilt from the Dutch decipherments of Michell's reports R1050/R1051: fragments only, the subject cannot be stated with confidence.

snip.cap: The head of the copy: Lettre du Roi de Prusse au Secrétaire Michell du 28 Decemb. 1751, the clear opening and the first lines of the code
snip.credit: Koninklijk Huisarchief, The Hague, Prins Willem V inv. 198, first page (image P2), via DECODE R1955

system: Michell's envoy code of 1751-52: a large numerical code of groups 2-5346 with half-groups (1½, 150½, 660½) and homophones even for de and que.
